completion_contract.corporate_action_policy: Renames, mergers, share-class changes, symbol reuse, and other identifier changes require explicit dated evidence. No alias is inferred.
completion_contract.required_evidence: A dated security-master/crosswalk must bind each event PERMNO to the historical market-data identifier and symbol on every unverified required date.

purpose: Stable security-identity gate for historical market-data joins. PERMNO anchors event identity; ticker continuity is never inferred across dates.
